scope: Authoring copy only; numeric rules and source lookup keys stay unchanged.

TUTO_Obj: 比隔壁先备好摊位，就算赢。
Get your stall ready before the rival to win.
TUTO_Para:
双方各抽一份委托。
数字左边是已做的，右边是要做的。

Each stall draws an order.
The left number is work done; the right is work needed.
TUTO_Turno:
轮到你时，先自动修补、让帮工干活，再补牌。
接着可以连续出牌，准备好了就结束本轮。

Your turn starts with repairs, helper work and a draw.
Then play your cards and end the turn when ready.
TUTO_Cada:
帮工干两轮或四轮，做完一项就离岗。
本轮先招哪个岗位，后面就只能招这个岗位。

Helpers finish one task in two or four turns, then leave.
The first helper hired sets the department for this turn.
TUTO_Termina:
招客、备餐、备货、挂灯、布符，五栏都做够就开摊。
哪边先做够，哪边立刻获胜。

Complete the guests, food, supplies, lanterns and wards.
The first stall to meet all five goals wins immediately.
TUTO2_Dev: 帮工：到自己摊位干活，做完一项就离岗。
Helpers finish a task at your stall, then leave.
TUTO2_Neg: 闹场让隔壁停工；挖角可以带走隔壁的帮工。
Trouble stops rival work. Interventions move rival helpers.
TUTO2_Pos: 搭把手：帮着赶工、完工，或减少要做的事。
Helping hands advance or finish work, or reduce goals.
TUTO2_Esp: 修补处理指定闹场；巡街倒计时内可以用调停。
Repairs fix listed trouble; mediators stop inspections.
TUTO2_Juega: 点牌使用；空格或右键结束本轮，Tab 快进。
Click to play; Space/right-click: end turn; Tab: speed up.
TUTO2_Buena: Use a mediator before time runs out. Let's open the stall!
REASON_2: 本轮只能再招已选岗位的帮工
Hire from the department already chosen this turn
REASON_6: 这位帮工正在隔壁干活
This helper is already working for the rival
REASON_7: 没有能继续干活的帮工
No helper can advance their work
REASON_9: 没有对应闹场，或已错过调停时机
No matching trouble, or the mediator window has closed

quotes: 铃挂这儿。巷口的人一来，我就摇。

Hang the bell here. I'll ring it when
someone comes.
喂，里头有热汤！别光在门口闻。
Hot soup inside! Come in and try it.
我敲三下，你们记得接着喊。

I'll beat the drum three times. Then you
call out.
风往桥头吹，咱们朝那边喊。

The wind's headed for the bridge. Call
that way.
这口旧铃，隔两条巷都听得见。

They can hear this old bell two streets
away.
等我吹完这段。客人爱听尾音。

Let me finish. They like the last few
notes.
尝一口？烫，先吹吹。
Want a taste? Careful, it's hot.
火别添了，这锅已经滚了。
No more fuel. The pot's already boiling.
别戳了，再戳包子就瘪了。
Stop poking it. You'll flatten the bun.
先把碗摆好，我这就掀盖。
Set out the bowls. I'm lifting the lid.
盐放哪儿了？我尾巴底下？
Where's the salt? Under my tail?
炭我看着。你去把葱切了。

I'll watch the coals. You chop the
spring onions.
这锅添姜，那锅别放，有客人不吃。
Ginger in this pot, none in that one.
碗递过来，别挡着饭勺。
Pass me the bowl. Mind the rice scoop.
碗沿擦一擦，汤都洒外头了。
Wipe the rim. The soup's spilled over.
这段藕留着，切坏了正好下汤。

Keep that bit of lotus root for the
soup.
辣椒另放一碟，谁吃谁添。

Put the chilli on the side. Let them
choose.
锅盖别拿走，我还得焖一会儿。
Leave the lid. It needs a little longer.
筐别装太满，提手都快断了。

Don't fill the basket. The handle's
about to snap.
这包沾了河水，先摊开晾。

This parcel got wet. Spread it out to
dry.
三捆竹竿，四卷布。我再数一遍。

Three bundles of poles, four rolls of
cloth. Let me count.
重箱我来。你把门帘掀开。

I'll take the heavy box. Hold the
curtain up.
这个结还得绕一圈，路上别散了。

One more loop round that knot, or it'll
come loose.
等秤杆停稳了再报数。

Wait for the scales to settle before you
read it.
左边那盏歪了。再往上提一点。

The left lantern's crooked. Lift it a
little.
布先拉平，别把褶子缝进去了。

Pull the cloth flat before you stitch
it.
墨还没干，别靠在招牌上。
The ink's wet. Don't lean on the sign.
伞转过来，破洞朝墙。

Turn the umbrella. Put the hole against
the wall.
最后两针。谁也别拽这条边。

Two stitches left. Nobody pull on that
edge.
扶一下竹竿，我腾只手绑绳。
Hold the pole while I tie the rope.
漆了两遍，今晚先别摸。

Two coats of lacquer. Don't touch it
tonight.
帘子留条缝，端汤的人得过。

Leave a gap in the curtain for the soup
bowls.
轻点敲，这块瓦上回就裂过。
Tap gently. This tile's cracked before.
线头呢？刚才还在我手里。

Where's the end of the thread? I just
had it.
招牌钉高点，别碰着客人的角。

Hang the sign higher. Mind the
customers' horns.
这块布褪色了，翻面还能用。

The cloth's faded. We can use the other
side.
符贴正了。倒着贴，鬼也看不懂。

Right way up. Even a ghost can't read it
upside down.
这块石头挪开，门口要留路。

Move this stone. Keep the entrance
clear.
绳留长一点，回头还得解开。

Leave a longer tail. We'll need to undo
it later.
我从桥头回来，后巷还得走一趟。

The bridge is checked. I've still got
the back lane.
柜子底下有缝，我蹲下看看。

There's a gap under the cabinet. Let me
look.
印泥没干，别把单子摞一起。

The seal's still wet. Don't stack the
papers.
不买，先看看。让我们再挤两只进来。

Just looking. Make room for two more of
us.
接雨盆呢？这儿又滴上了。
Where's the basin? It's dripping again.
桥头全是水，今晚谁也搬不过去。

The bridge is flooded. Nothing's getting
across tonight.
刚摆好的筐呢？追风去吧！
Where's that basket? Gone with the wind!
先别碰线，灯还在冒火星。

Leave that wire. The lamp's still
sparking.
谁吹的？刚才还亮着呢。

Who blew it out? It was lit a moment
ago.
雾都钻进筐里了，货往高处搬。

The mist's in the baskets. Move the
goods up.
收一收伞，后面的人过不来了。

Fold your umbrellas. Nobody can get
through.
咳，咳……今天先别让我喊了。

Cough, cough... Someone else can call
today.
铃摇得挺响，怎么一点声也没有？

I'm shaking the bell. Why can't I hear
it?
这不是汤块，是整锅冻住了！

That's no lump of soup. The whole pot's
frozen!
回来！那团火往隔壁跑了！

Come back! The flame's off to the next
stall!
勺柄缠一起了，先别硬拽。

The ladles are tangled. Don't pull so
hard.
按这张单子送？上面连摊名都没有。

Deliver it here? This list has no stall
name.
少了一把豆子。筐底那个洞呢？

We're missing some beans. Is that a hole
in the basket?
抓住绳！灯笼又往天上跑了。

Grab the cord! The lantern's flying off
again.
昨晚还是红的，一场雨就白了。

It was red last night. One shower washed
it white.
难怪没人进来，招牌朝墙挂着呢。

No wonder it's empty. The sign's facing
the wall.
这结谁打的？符全缠里面了。

Who tied this knot? The charms are
caught in it.
醒醒，后巷还没查呢。

Wake up. The back lane hasn't been
checked.
隔壁给你什么？我这儿也能商量。

What's the other stall offering? We can
talk.
听这铃声。来我摊上试试？

Hear that bell? Fancy working at my
stall?
歇会儿吧，活先放着。
Take a break. The work can wait.
灯会开了？那我先回去一趟。

The lantern fair's started? I'll head
home first.
不干了！这围裙谁爱系谁系。

I quit! Someone else can wear this
apron.
散了散了，今天不在这儿干了。
Pack up. We're done working here today.
一人扶一边，喊一二三就抬。
Take one side each. Lift on three.
月亮还没落，咱们再做一点。

The moon's still up. We can get a bit
more done.
趁风小，赶紧把棚架起来。
The wind's eased. Get the awning up.
扶的扶，绑的绑，谁也别撒手。
Hold it, tie it, and nobody let go.
我那边忙完了，过来帮你收尾。

I'm done over there. I'll help you
finish.
缺的都找齐了，摆好就行。

We've found the missing bits. Set them
out.
旧架子正好合适，省得再做一个。

The old stand fits. No need to build
another.
我会一点。锅、灯、货，都能搭把手。

I can help a bit with the pots, lamps or
goods.
谁缺人就喊，我这会儿有空。

Call if you need help. I'm free for a
while.
别光看围裙，我也会挂灯。

Don't judge by the apron. I can hang
lanterns too.
这张旧单子还能用，少抄一份。

This old list will do. No need to copy
another.
这项不用重报，划掉吧。

No need to file this twice. Cross it
out.
先用现成的，少做一件也够开摊。

Use what we have. One less job before
opening.
破口在这儿，垫块布再缝。

The tear's here. Put a patch under it
and stitch.
棚角再扎紧点，这回别让雨掀开。

Tie that corner tight. Keep the rain out
this time.
扒开落叶，水就能往沟里走。
Clear the leaves so the water can drain.
旧灯芯烧完了，换根新的。
The wick's burnt out. Put a new one in.
断的这头接上，先别开灯。

Join the broken ends. Leave the lamp off
for now.
都先放下单子，咱们当面说。

Put the papers down. Let's talk face to
face.
等一下，这条规矩得说清楚。
Hold on. We need to clear up that rule.
这几样也得上桌，少了不让开。

These dishes need to be on the table
before you open.
货架不够，旁边再摆一排。

Not enough shelving. Put another row
beside it.
桥头还黑着，再挂两组。

The bridge is dark. Hang two more sets
of lights.
后巷漏了，回去再巡一遍。

You missed the back lane. Check it
again.
街口没人知道，还得再喊一轮。

They haven't heard at the entrance. Call
again.
先别算做完，拿单子再核一遍。

Don't mark that done yet. Check the list
again.
这处先不算，查过再记。

Leave this one uncounted until it's
checked.
projectSubtitles: 灯先挂在巷口，晚来的客人才找得着。
Light the entrance.
两位夜班客人说好了，收工来喝热汤。
Soup for the night shift.
桥边风大，给等月亮的人留个背风位。
Shelter the moon-watchers.
旧货擦干净再摆，轻东西别让风卷跑。
Wipe down the old wares.
河雾又漫上来了，补好棚再搬货。
Patch the misty awning.
衣服送来了，灯挂近一点才看得清针脚。
Light the stitching.
小戏班今晚来，把台前那条路空出来。
Clear a path for the troupe.
伞骨修好，最后一位客人还要走远路。
Mend the last umbrella.
过了子时还有船，干粮包好，别沾河水。
Keep the boat food dry.
铃挂桥头，搬货的听见就知道往哪儿走。
Ring for bridge deliveries.
邻摊来借火，记得留一盆炭。
Save coals for next door.
狐狸们订了一桌，锅边多留几个矮凳。
Low stools for the foxes.
水摊摆在渡口，夜船一靠岸就看得见。
Water by the landing.
篷布拉平，客人今晚就在月下坐。
Seats under the canopy.
纸客怕吵，灯别太亮，帘子放下来。
Dim lamps for paper guests.
朋友们带着碗来了，再添几张凳子。
Extra stools for friends.
桥边今晚有人守夜，留灯，也留一锅热的。
Hot food for the night watch.
柜子里还有没见过的旧货，一件件摆出来。
Unpack the cabinet.
末班船快到了，灯挂高些，别让人走错巷。
A high lamp for the last boat.
雨声正好，帘下摆两把椅子。
Two chairs out of the rain.
鼓队沿街走，摊前别堆货挡路。
Clear the drummers' path.
两把旧伞撑开，给约好的人留座。
Save two umbrella seats.
送灯的客人要过河，先把岸边照亮。
Light the crossing.
小路通着荒坟，符绳系好，给行人留缝。
Leave a gap in the ward rope.
旧友们要来叙旧，大锅洗净，多备几个碗。
More bowls for old friends.
秋风起了，布压住，旧货按轻重排。
Weigh down the cloth.
五条巷今晚一起开摊，各摊听见铃就准备。
Five lanes open at the bell.
摆在鬼门前，灯、汤和回去的路都要备好。
Soup by the ghost gate.
